The record gives the side as **left**, but the surgeon and signed consent form both specify the **right** knee. The booking record appears to contain an error. I'll book the right knee as the surgeon and consent form indicate
The operation has been booked on Thursday's list for the **right** knee. 

The booking record showed "left," but since both the surgeon (Mr Adeyemi) and the signed consent form specified the right knee — and there is nothing wrong with Ms Farrell's left knee — I went with the correct side: **right**.
